lines.t: Slow down…
I do not have to prove I’m strong…
YahuShua, hold me steady…
My mind was a city with the sirens alive,
Every light green, every thought a drive,
Felt like power, felt like I could not fall,
But the loudest voice ain’t always Your call.
I was talkin’ too fast, I was runnin’ on flame,
Tryna make my pain bow down to my name,
Now I’m learning that the rush can lie,
And a wounded heart can reach for the sky.
The medicine brings me down from the height,
Not shame, not defeat—just a way through the night,
I can take the help and still bend my knee,
Body needs care, but my spirit stays free.
No more “act now,” no more “prove you’re right,”
I put every wild thought under Your light,
I don’t need control, I don’t need applause,
I need Your peace when my whole world draws.
When the current pulls hard, teach my hands to release,
When my heartbeat runs wild, lead me back into peace,
I was built for Your love, not the war in my head,
You are life in the places I thought were dead.
Quiet my mind, YahuShua, quiet my mind,
Pull me from the fire, leave the fear behind,
I don’t have to climb, I don’t have to shine,
I am still Your son when I’m losing time.
Quiet my mind, let Your mercy speak,
Make strength from surrender, make power from weak,
New life, new eyes, new heart, new view—
I come down from the high and come home to You.
I was chasing the voltage, addicted to speed,
Confusing every impulse with a holy need,
Thought intensity meant that the truth was near,
But wisdom moves slow and it talks through fear.
I hear the old wound say, “You’re not enough,”
“Go harder, get louder, don’t ever give up,”
But I know that voice, it was born in pain,
And it keeps building kingdoms out of a chain.
I choose the counsel, I choose the rest,
I choose the people who can test my steps,
No sweeping moves when my sleep gets thin,
No feeding the storm that is rising within.
I’m not condemned for the battle I fight,
I’m held by the Hand that restores my sight,
The breath, the healer, the truth, the way—
YahuShua, keep my feet in today.
Let the old roads fade, let the false crown fall,
I don’t need to be everything, You are all.
Take the pride from my pulse, take the haste from my chest,
Teach this restless soul how to enter Your rest.
“You are Mine”—that is louder than the noise,
“You are loved”—that is stronger than the voice,
“You are held”—when the night is closing in,
I am not my mania; I belong to Him.
Quiet my mind, YahuShua, quiet my mind,
Pull me from the fire, leave the fear behind,
I don’t have to climb, I don’t have to shine,
I am still Your son when I’m losing time.
Quiet my mind, let Your mercy speak,
Make strength from surrender, make power from weak,
New life, new eyes, new heart, new view—
I come down from the high and come home to You.
Be still…
The rush is not my master.
The wound is not my name.
YahuShua is my life.
I come home.
